title: Console: after the session ends server-side, in-app navigation shows "Page Not Found" or "check your connection" instead of returning to the login page
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible, reproduced three times through the console).

QA-source: #32135 · platform-core.console-login · clause 3

## What happens

When a console session ends on the server (sign-out elsewhere, expiry, revocation), the next in-app navigation keeps the whole signed-in shell and tells the user the page is missing or the network is down. It never returns them to the login page until they reload.

## Reproduction (framework ff04ad81, stock showcase, own port and DB)

1. Sign in through the form at `/_console/login` (admin, or `auditor.demo@example.com` / `showcase123`) and wait for `/_console/home`.
2. End the session server-side: `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out` → 200.
3. Without reloading, click the "Showcase" tile on Home, or any sidebar link.

- Expected: the console sends the user to the login page (with `?redirect=`), or shows a re-authentication prompt.
- Actual: every API call answers 401; the sidebar, avatar and notification badge stay; the main area reads "Page Not Found — The page \"showcase_capability_map\" could not be found. It may have been removed or renamed." Object lists read "Couldn't load records … Check your connection and try again" with a Retry button. Only a full page reload goes to `/login?redirect=…`.
- Reproduced three times, two personas, ref-targeted clicks.

## Reach

The console itself, every signed-in user. No stale records are shown, but a 401 is presented as a missing page or a network fault.

## Why it matters

A user whose session ended (timeout, password change, admin revoke) is told the app is broken instead of being asked to sign in again; support will chase a "page removed" that never happened.

## Reader

Triage first touch; the fix lands in `ui/` (the console's handling of a 401 on in-app navigation, which today only the full-reload path redirects).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack session expired page not found` (152 hits, open and closed), `sign-out shell 401 redirect login` (31), `session expiry console redirect` (64): no card for this behaviour; closest are #29174 (redirect carries the previous user's filters) and #29971 (mobile hand-off lands on 页面不存在), both different.
